datasets.name: A known contact revisiting pricing MERGES and pauses nurture

data.reason: SOP §03: a known contact returning to pricing is a buying signal on an EXISTING relationship. Creating a second record would split their history and let generic nurture keep running at somebody actively evaluating — so it merges, rescores, and pauses the sequence rather than starting a new thread.

datasets.name: Checkout started is the HIGHEST priority

data.reason: SOP §03: someone who started a checkout and did not finish has the highest demonstrated intent of any signal — they tried to pay and something stopped them. Treated at HIGHEST priority because the window in which help is useful is hours, not days.

datasets.name: An unidentifiable interested comment is refused, not invented

data.reason: SOP §03: a public comment expressing interest becomes a record ONLY when the person is identifiable. Acknowledged publicly and answered privately, because the reply carries information the commenter may not want under a public post. This signal matched that rule but the person could not be identified, so no record and no identity were created.

datasets.name: A completed purchase goes to CLOSED WON, not to a lead

data.reason: SOP §03: a completed licence purchase is not a lead. Creating one would put a paying customer back into a sales sequence, which is the most reliable way to annoy somebody who has just given you money.

datasets.name: An unknown signal kind defaults to NO_RECORD

data.reason: No rule in the SOP §03 table describes this signal, so no record is created. An unclassified signal is one nobody has decided about, and guessing CREATE would let an unreviewed event type manufacture leads and identities.

errorCategory.guidance:
The authenticated user doesn't have permission for this endpoint.

**Possible causes:**
1. Endpoint requires specific role (admin, owner, etc.)
2. User doesn't own the resource being accessed
3. Missing or invalid authentication token

**Recommended action:**
Add requiresRole to your API definition to document the required permissions:
```json
{
  "endpoint": "/api/leadflow/ai/coach/scorecard/:callId",
  "method": "GET",
  "requiresRole": ["admin"],  // or ["owner"], ["manager"], etc.
  "testability": "manual",
  "skipReason": "Requires elevated permissions"
}
```
